primaryChecks.text: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
primaryChecks.nextContext: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)
